purpose: Teach: ハイブリッド/ハンセン病/要塞/点字/沸騰/磁石/ワイヤー/リフト

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがハイブリッド車を買ったのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad bought a hybrid car.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone. Sharing a small domestic detail with gentle affection. Slight lift at the end — inviting his reaction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ハンセン病の絵本読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I read a picture book about Hansen's disease at school.
lines.style: Quiet pride in his voice. Careful enunciation — he's been thinking about this. Slight uncertainty underneath, testing whether it's the right thing to have shared.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが要塞のお話してくれるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Grandpa says he'll tell you a story about fortresses.
lines.style: Gentle, almost conspiratorial. Like she's bringing him good news. Warm cadence — she knows this will matter to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、学校で点字を学んだよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I learned braille at school today.
lines.style: Bright, direct statement. Small boy wanting to be heard. Pride threading through, but also seeking her acknowledgment. Open and unguarded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お湯が沸騰したらお父さんを呼びましょうね
lines.en: Sho, when the water boils, we'll call your dad, won't we?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact instruction wrapped in gentle togetherness. Practical but warm — making him part of the task. Light, unrushed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、磁石でクリップ集めて遊んだよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I collected clips with a magnet and played with them.
lines.style: Quick, eager recounting. Energy of a child who wants her to see what he was doing. Breathless slightly — rushing to get it all out before she moves on.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがワイヤーアートを作って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad made a wire art sculpture for you.
lines.style: Appreciative, almost marveling tone. Sharing something made with care. Soft, reflective — she's noticing the thoughtfulness behind the gesture.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、スキー場のリフトにお父さんと乗ったよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I rode the ski lift with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, breathless final claim. Peak of excitement — this was the thing he was waiting to tell her. Close and intimate in his delivery, holding her attention.
